description.en: HoloCount evaluates multimodal large language models on visual counting tasks across three levels: semantic counting (atomic and property-based enumeration), analytical counting (logical composition via spatial and set-based reasoning), and robustness testing (adverse scenarios and grounded counter-priors). The benchmark uses a hierarchical taxonomy and provides a dataset for evaluation.

claire_radar.whyItMatters: Existing counting benchmarks fail to capture complex failure modes under logical constraints or adversarial conditions. HoloCount provides a structured diagnostic tool to assess MLLM quantitative precision, revealing performance gaps as tasks shift from perception to analytical reasoning, and guiding development of more grounded multimodal systems.
